commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'
PKG='pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'
adb start-server >/dev/null
adb connect "$SEL" >/dev/null
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r')" = 'RFCT70L7E8J'
echo '--- identity/vault filenames ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell run-as "$PKG" sh -c 'find . -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -name "*identity*" -o -name "*vault*" -o -name "*.bak" \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort'
echo '--- no_backup ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell run-as "$PKG" sh -c 'ls -la no_backup 2>/dev/null || true'
echo '--- app dirs ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell run-as "$PKG" sh -c 'ls -ld . no_backup files shared_prefs 2>/dev/null || true'
